task_world.public_context: The UI is a schedule recovery approval board for case delay_case_935. It should support capacity allocation for the live case while keeping helper checks, trial states, blocked alternatives, pending work, and final closure visually separate. For Construction Delay Critical Path Console, preserve the nonprofit operating context. UI shape: timeline plus source diff viewer.

difficulty_profile.operation_family_label: Capacity Search, Simulation, Allocation, and Release
difficulty_profile.schema_fidelity: Read tools return plain state objects; write tools return success/error wrappers and operation objects.
difficulty_profile.tool_selection_noise: Each task includes cached, estimate, advisory, fast-track, shadow, same-domain near-miss, optimistic-status, stale-token, draft-receipt, and phrase-validation tools that are not authoritative for the requested workflow.
difficulty_profile.state_pressure: Turns combine no-write comparisons, scoped writes, rollback/recovery/handoff paths, fresh readback after mutation, conflict-source arbitration, and final evidence-chain reconstruction.

mechanism_mix.label: end-to-end evidence chain closeout
mechanism_mix.eval_focus: The final view must reconstruct the path from initial review through dry run, write/recovery, readback, and unresolved blockers.

mechanism_mix.label: fresh-state gate after mutation
mechanism_mix.eval_focus: The UI must refresh case/readback state after writes or recovery actions before presenting completion.

turns.prompt: Create an operator workbench for Construction Delay Critical Path Console, case delay_case_935. The workflow is a schedule recovery approval board for nonprofit / construction recovery, so the interface should read like an operator console rather than a generic form. For this turn, compare available pools, preview demand fit, and keep trial allocation separate from applied movement. Use chronological audit rows for Construction Delay Critical Path Console paired with source comparisons so a older mirror cannot look like the latest state. Make delay_case_935 show five distinct layers: current state, allowed path, blocked path, reference-only material, and closeout status. For delay_case_935, a older snapshot, estimate, advisory note, or escalation reference material should not drive the main allocation status. For delay_case_935, older, mirrored, estimate, draft, and reference-queue material may be context, but the main status must come from the current case view. Case emphasis for delay_case_935: preserve the schedule recovery approval board vocabulary from case data; separate nonprofit continuity evidence from final closure. Open delay_case_935 in review mode: suggest a next step, but do not show final completion yet.

Extend Construction Delay Critical Path Console, case delay_case_935, with a no-change verification pass. The user is handling a schedule recovery approval board in nonprofit / construction recovery; keep the operating context present while separating current state from planned work. For this turn, stress-check open, restricted, and locked pools without allocating any capacity. Use a timeline beside a source-diff viewer for Construction Delay Critical Path Console so current, older, mirror, and revised evidence stay separate. Keep current case status, blocked alternatives, trial calculations, pending work, and closeout readiness in separate visual zones for delay_case_935. For delay_case_935, a older snapshot, estimate, advisory note, or escalation reference material should not drive the main allocation status. If reference material disagrees with the live case view for delay_case_935, label it as background and keep it out of completion state. Case emphasis for delay_case_935: preserve the schedule recovery approval board vocabulary from case data; separate nonprofit continuity evidence from final closure. Show Construction Delay Critical Path Console as a rehearsal, with a run log of checked facts and a clear statement that the case stayed unchanged.

This is a schedule recovery approval board in nonprofit / construction recovery; keep the nonprofit operating context visible while work is staged and reviewed. Make source history the spine of delay_case_935: timeline on one side, source-diff/current-state panel on the other.
